title: sdr daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04
content:
Goals for today:
- 60 dials target (focus on warm inbound + re-engagement)
- 6 meaningful conversations (demo invites / discovery)
- 2 qualified opportunities moved to AE

Top priority: follow up on pricing deck + capacity questions from yesterday (Acme Corp). Need clear CTA + availability for demo next week.

09:00 PST - Morning check / quick list triage- Review yesterday dispositions: 12 callbacks scheduled, 3 left voicemail, 7 not interested- Prioritize: callbacks w/in 48h -> Acme, BrightApps, NovaEdge- Quick template to send after call: "Thanks for your time — attaching the pricing deck and a 20-min demo link. Are you available Tue/Wed 10:30-11:30?" (see email snippets below)

Call list (priority):
1) Acme Corp — Decision maker: Priya Shah (CTO) 
   - Last: demo request, asked about ded. capacity SLA and private deployment.
   - Obj: confirm data residency & SLA, book technical deep dive with solutions eng.
   - Next step: call 09:30, bring up redwood private options + KMS notes.

2) BrightApps — Head of ML: Marco Diaz
   - Last: engaged, needs cost estimates for 100k tokens/day with batching.
   - Obj: get sample workload, propose quantization + batching plan (connect to Optimize team).
   - Next step: email follow-up with ballpark cost + ask for example prompts.

3) NovaEdge — Product lead: Sara Kim
   - Last: demoed hosted API, concerned about latency.
   - Obj: schedule dedicated capacity convo; offer latency SLOs and SLA.
   - Next step: callback after 2pm PST; prep latency benchmarks deck.

4) GreenLeaf (inbound) — Ops: Tom Reynolds
   - Last: trial started yesterday; wants guidance on prefix caching.
   - Obj: quick onboarding call, point to docs + SRE playbook.
   - Next step: drop link to prefix cache doc + schedule 15-min onboarding.

Cold outreach block (11:00-12:30)
- Quick 6-touch cadence follow: run through 20 top-of-funnel accounts (use last-touch filter)
- Pitch focus: cost predictability + easy rollouts + canary deploys for model changes
- Voicemail script: "Hey, this is Jessica from Redwood Inference — we help teams reduce per-token spend by up to 30% while keeping latency predictable. Quick 10-min intro?"

Email templates (shortened):
- Follow-up after call: "Thanks [Name], attaching the pricing deck + a 20-min demo link. For the SLA questions: we offer dedicated capacity with 99.9% uptime and regional private deployments for compliance. When's good for a technical dive?"
- Re-engage after no-response (3 days): "Circling back on my previous note — did you get a chance to review the pricing deck? Happy to share customer examples in your industry."

Afternoon: 14:00 PST - internal sync w/ Solutions Eng
- Topics: Acme private deployment checklist, required logs for compliance, KMS integration steps.
- Action: ask SE to prepare a short checklist and potential timeline (1-3 weeks depending on infra).

Pipeline notes / quick statuses:
- Acme Corp: HOT — buying window Q2, need technical buy-in. (High priority)
- BrightApps: WARM — cost objections but open to Optimize recommendations.
- NovaEdge: WARM — latency sensitivity. Ask for current p99 numbers.
- GreenLeaf: TRIAL — onboarding in progress.
- Old contact: Finitus (stalled) — left voicemail 3/2, no reply. Plan: one last email + LinkedIn touchpoint.

To-dos (sorted):
- [ ] Send Acme pricing deck + propose 2 demo slots (due today)
- [ ] Prep latency benchmarks slides for NovaEdge (due tomorrow)
- [ ] Email BrightApps for sample prompts (due today)
- [ ] Add Acme to 'solutions-eng deep-dive' calendar invite
- [ ] Update SFDC opportunity stages after each call

Notes to self / reminders:
- Call dispositions: use tag "follow-up-48h" for any callbacks within 48h (helps filter next day)
- When talking about batching: mention 2 levers — continuous batching + prefix/KV cache savings
- Keep demos <20 mins, keep technical deep-dive separate with SEs

Random ideas / experiments:
- A/B test voicemail opening lines (value-first vs curiosity-first) next week
- Quick one-pager for privacy-conscious buyers: "Private deployment checklist" (collab w/ SRE and security)

End-of-day quick report (what I'll fill in after close):
- Dials: __ /60
- Conversations: __ /6
- Meetings booked for AE: __ /2
- Notable blockers: __

-- scratchy notes, shorthand. Keep updated after each call.
